basis: Semantic statements and fixed crops extracted from the existing reviewed v15/v4 recipe catalog. Recorded product evidence only; new narration still requires creative and factual review before publication. No live trades, current prices, offers or results.

claims.account: Use the exact TradingView account supplied for confirmed indicator access.
claims.invite-list: The recorded Indicators menu includes an Invite-only list for scripts the account can access.

sources.summary: Check the exact account and its confirmed invite-only indicator access.

claims.inputs: The recorded settings show separate display inputs. Inspect one control at a time.
claims.cloud-toggle: Show Trend Cloud is a visible display input in this recorded view.
claims.edge-lines: Cloud edge lines have their own visible control in the recorded settings.

sources.summary: Inspect the recorded display controls one at a time.

claims.selected-timeframe: Read the selected chart timeframe before interpreting a recorded example. A timeframe alone is not an entry rule.

sources.summary: Read the selected timeframe before interpreting a recorded chart.

claims.scalp-name: Scalp and Swing are distinct Darth Algo tools. Check the loaded tool name before interpreting its view.
claims.scalp-context: This owned image is a recorded Darth Algo Scalp product view, not a new trade or an executed order.

sources.summary: Check the Scalp tool name and surrounding recorded chart context.

claims.swing-name: This owned image is a recorded Darth Algo Swing product view. Read its name and surrounding price context.
claims.wider-chart: Keep the surrounding candles visible when reviewing one displayed feature.

sources.summary: Keep the Swing tool name and surrounding candles in view.

claims.cloud-context: The recorded Swing view shows candles around a colored trend cloud. The cloud provides visual context; entry rules require separate checks.
claims.cloud-review: Compare different sections of the same recorded chart without inferring trading performance.

sources.summary: Review the colored cloud alongside the candles in this recorded Swing view.

claims.scalp-levels: The recorded Scalp plan has separate entry, stop and target labels. These are displayed levels, not proof that orders executed.
claims.own-rules: Position size, entry rules and order handling need their own checks outside a displayed chart plan.

sources.summary: Displayed entry, stop and target levels are different from executed orders.

claims.swing-levels: The recorded Swing plan shows entry, stop and target levels in one chart context. A marked target is not an achieved result.

sources.summary: Read the displayed Swing plan together without treating a target as an achieved result.

claims.signal-context: A displayed signal is a starting point for examining chart context, not a complete trade or overall performance record.
claims.example-limits: A selected recorded screenshot cannot establish overall trading performance.

sources.summary: A displayed signal starts a context review; it is not a complete trading record.
